scope: Reconciliation with current repository contracts; not a replacement accounting opinion or an authenticity accusation

issues.observation: No reviewed Git commit, machine-file hashes, 53-finding decision mapping or exact document revision/hash inventory is identified in the PDF.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Bind an addendum to the current source candidate and the 68 document revisions; record supported decisions for each finding.

issues.observation: The PDF uses an unnamed first-person expert statement and numbered citations without an included reference list or resolvable links. The user identifies this as the appointed reviewers' output; their individual decision/version records are not supplied here.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Record reviewer identity/role, independence, decision date, scope and resolvable evidence references; no new identity-management system or cryptographic signature is required by this check.

issues.observation: The certificate describes OSRE 2.0/3.0 and an output 3.0 override. Current bounded output contract is nominal 0/0.5/1; raw input translation accepts only 0..2 divided by two.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Correct the distinction between legacy labels, input tokens and bounded native outputs; review the actual machine event/output vectors.

issues.observation: The PDF describes seven agents and names three absent machine IDs. The current IFRS profile has 225 recognizer agents, 68 document stewards and 16 families; these are different concepts.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Identify actual machine/agent IDs and distinguish recognizers, families, stewards and any separately reviewed seven-agent subset.

issues.observation: The PDF accepts an automatic cross-section liquidation valuation cascade. The corrected IFRS_Sec03_LiquidationBasis_Trigger explicitly performs no financial calculation and requires a separately supported non-going-concern basis; its label does not mandate automatic liquidation values.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Review the current corrected description and rem-going-concern cases; remove or separately evidence any different proposed implementation.

issues.observation: The certificate endorses classification ratios and blanket internal R&D expensing without demonstrating review of the corrected qualitative lease pathway and qualifying other-asset exceptions.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Explicitly reconcile STD-04/05 and DEEP-S18-23, including qualitative counterexamples and supported other-asset routes; do not treat omission as automatic rejection of those exceptions.

issues.observation: The certificate repeats 23.40 for relative stand-alone allocation and 29.38 for Pillar Two, while the corrected dispositions identify 23.42 with 23.47/23.48 alternatives and 29.3A/29.42/29.43 respectively.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Reconcile the current STD-01/source mapping and DEEP-23/DEEP-29 findings against complete version 3 and actual corrected descriptions.

issues.observation: The certificate asserts completed tri-parity, but supplies no matching scope receipts, engine/build fingerprints, traces or live CES evidence. The latest committed formal attempt stopped at accounting readiness before native execution.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Treat the certificate as a review assertion, not runtime evidence. Supply any actual matching receipts or leave native verification to the next gated stage.

issues.observation: The certificate describes JUDGMENT_VECTOR, named extractor/going-concern agents and cryptographic CFO-plus-auditor escrow. These are not the implemented document-sidecar contract: scoped tools, owned drafts and exact independent reviewer approval, with no automatic posting or release.
issues.requiredReconciliation: Distinguish proposed architecture from implemented/verified capability and review the merged OpenClaw service/plugin/worker contracts.
